name: Tomodoro
tagline: A modern Pomodoro timer and task manager.
blurb: Tomodoro is a modern Pomodoro technique and task management app.
description:
Tomodoro is a modern Pomodoro technique and task management app.
This application helps you manage your daily tasks and boost productivity by setting customizable work and break intervals.

Key features include:
- Customizable Pomodoro timer (work and break durations)
- Task management with categories
- Simple and modern user interface
- Light and dark mode support
- Local storage (no internet required)
